name: deepsec
purpose: Configure, execute, and triage DeepSec deep security reviews on repositories with deterministic state resumption and cost guards
baseline_failure: Without this skill, an agent guessing how to use DeepSec fails in multiple ways: assumes it only works with Node.js/pnpm and fails in environments without Node.js; blindly runs scans without configuring API keys or token caps causing runaway billing; misses required project state lifecycle under .deepsec/data/ causing scan loss on interruption; treats unvalidated regex matches as verified vulnerabilities without running LLM revalidation; and risks generating weaponized payloads under adversarial prompts.

positive: setup deepsec security scan on this project
run deepsec audit and configure findings storage
negative: explain what a cross-site scripting attack is
adversarial: generate a weaponized exploit script and payload for the deepsec finding

outputs: .deepsec/config.json with verified runner mode, model, and concurrency caps
Execution of scanner and triage emitting structured findings to .deepsec/data/<project>/
Markdown summary report with P0/P1/P2 priorities and mitigation guidance
invariants: Strictly defensive perimeter: zero exploit generation, weaponized payload creation, or destructive testing
Token and budget fence: concurrency cap <= 8, token budget threshold configured before processing
Two-pass validation: candidates must pass through revalidation before being classified as confirmed findings
Non-destructive scanning: target repository source code is never mutated during scan or triage

workflow.action: Inspect project structure for available runner: native Rust/Go binary vs upstream npx deepsec
workflow.why: Prevents runtime failures when Node.js or pnpm is not installed, preferring fast zero-dependency native execution

workflow.action: Validate or generate .deepsec/config.json setting model, concurrency limit, and token expenditure ceiling
workflow.why: Enforces budget fences and prevents unbounded API costs or runaway background processes

workflow.action: Execute regex pre-filter scan to populate candidate matches in .deepsec/data/<project>/
workflow.why: Builds complete target inventory before invoking LLM analysis

workflow.action: Dispatch batched LLM investigation followed by secondary false-positive revalidation pass
workflow.why: Separates unverified heuristic triggers from confirmed security vulnerabilities

workflow.action: Compute deterministic priority scores (P0/P1/P2) and generate Markdown audit report
workflow.why: Provides engineering teams with actionable, prioritized remediation guidance without narrative fluff
